responsibility: This header defines the `neoversev1_tunings` model for Arm Neoverse V1 in the AArch64 backend. It supplies Neoverse-V1-specific address costs, register-move costs, AdvSIMD and SVE vector cost tables, scalar/vector issue-resource descriptions, a fixed 256-bit SVE width assumption, and Neoverse-oriented tune flags, giving GCC the cost and throughput model needed for V1-focused vectorization, instruction costing, and scheduling.
